title: Childcare Incident Checklist
subtitle: Capture room headcount, care transition, observed condition, and immediate comfort; confirm guardian notice and center review.
description: Childcare Incident records room headcount, care transition, observed condition, immediate comfort, guardian notice, and center review. Childcare Incident evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this childcare incident stage-gated verification when staff must document room headcount and care transition. Reconcile observed condition, immediate comfort, guardian notice, and center review before the childcare incident handoff. Use the room attendance sheet, staffing ratio record, care-transition timestamp, objective observation, first-aid supply record, guardian call log, and director review. Ask the assigned childcare incident reviewer to confirm room headcount against the organization's policy.

sections.title: Childcare Incident contact and reference
sections.guidance: Reconcile room headcount and care transitions; document observed condition, comfort provided, guardian notice, staff response, and center-level review.

sections.title: Childcare Incident checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current childcare incident facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Childcare Incident required checks
items: Room headcount is identified for this record
Care transition matches the current request or source
Observed condition is ready for point-of-use staff
Immediate comfort limits or questions are resolved
Guardian notice is communicated to the responsible person
Center review is confirmed at handoff
A changed childcare incident fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Childcare Incident failed or pending items

sections.title: Childcare Incident exception review and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold childcare incident readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Childcare Incident reviewer receipt
blocks.guidance: Childcare Incident receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
